title: Fit the denoising path inside one request envelope
description: Choose a workload and sampler, then tune steps and guidance. The modeled path updates latency, quality, diversity, and artifact risk together.
notice: Illustrative planning model. Replace every coefficient with measurements from one pinned model, scheduler, device, precision, and evaluation set.

workloads.label: Interactive preview
workloads.detail: Return a direction quickly so the user can revise the prompt.

workloads.label: Standard publish
workloads.detail: Balance prompt adherence, visual quality, and editor latency.

workloads.label: Premium export
workloads.detail: Spend more compute only when measured output quality earns it.

samplers.label: DDIM-style path
samplers.detail: A deterministic-compatible path useful for replay-oriented comparisons.

samplers.label: Multistep solver
samplers.detail: Reuses earlier model evaluations to reach the modeled quality region in fewer steps.

samplers.label: Ancestral sampler
samplers.detail: Adds stochasticity during sampling and usually needs a separately measured step profile.
